Message:
tcp: Fix data-races around sysctl knobs related to SYN option.

While reading these knobs, they can be changed concurrently.
Thus, we need to add READ_ONCE() to their readers.

  - tcp_sack
  - tcp_window_scaling
  - tcp_timestamps

Fixes: 1da177e4c3f4 ("Linux-2.6.12-rc2")
